## Codex 重置预测看板 2.3.2

- 历史重置列表新增本机额度补充记录，每条右侧醒目显示补充前最后记录的剩余百分比。
- 各额度周期的最后一次有效读数保存在本机。缺失的前值可用该次补充前最后一份可信快照补齐，并显示采样时间；没有可用读数或快照时显示“未记录”。

- 有本机读数时，公开重置记录右侧显示该条记录时间之前最后保存的额度与读取时间。

## English

- Reset history includes local quota refill entries, with the last remaining percentage recorded before each refill highlighted on the right.
- The last valid reading from each quota cycle is saved locally. The last trusted snapshot before a refill can fill a missing reading and show its sampling time; entries without a usable reading or snapshot show “Not recorded”.

- When available, public reset entries show the last local quota reading saved before the recorded reset time and its reading time.
